title: PPIA-14 Source Gaps and Resolution State

gaps.subject: MV-IA-F024 Pack Lifecycle and Canonical Content Registry
gaps.finding: PPIA-13 records F024 as referenced but unavailable as a completed canonical feature packet.
gaps.rule: Do not invent Pack lifecycle states, permission reasons, actions, recovery semantics or wording. Use only Pack facts already established by other authoritative contracts.

gaps.subject: Complete final PPIA-14 microcopy library
gaps.finding: The Foundation intentionally left complete state-by-state wording unfinished.
gaps.resolution: PPIA-14_MICROCOPY_LIBRARY_v0.1.0.json now supplies stable state-by-state baseline wording, localization keys, nonvisual equivalents, disclosure rules and safe action bindings for all 18 Foundation states.
gaps.resolution_boundary: Resolution covers the PPIA-14 wording-library gap only. It does not resolve P14-GAP-001/F024, create upstream behavior, or complete PPIA-14 overall.

rules: A gap is not permission to invent behavior, state, reason, action or canonical truth.
F024-specific Pack lifecycle copy remains unavailable until authoritative behavior exists.
Ordinary-user presentation of governance source gaps falls back to safe-unavailable when disclosure is not authorized.
Resolved wording does not become gameplay, permission, recovery, entitlement, approval, Pack or runtime authority.
